name: RL10A-3-3A hot-gas property node axial locations and expansion ratios
source: Binder, M., Tomsik, T., Veres, J. P., 'RL10A-3-3A Rocket Engine Modeling Project', NASA TM-107318, 1997. Table E1, p. 139 (NTRS 19970010379).
notes: These are the fourteen-plus-two axial locations used for the CET93 hot-gas property tables; they coincide with the heat-transfer calculation nodes of the regenerative cooling jacket.
Axial location is measured with respect to the throat, negative forward (towards the injector).
Expansion ratio is the local flow area divided by the throat area, A/A_t. Values below the throat station are contraction ratios on the subsonic branch.
In the published table the rows are ordered by ascending expansion ratio, which interleaves the subsonic and supersonic branches. They are sorted here by ascending axial position instead.
The throat itself (x = 0, area_ratio = 1) is not a row in the published table.

columns.x_in: axial location with respect to the throat [in]
columns.x: axial location with respect to the throat [m]
columns.branch: 'sub' for the subsonic branch, 'sup' for the supersonic branch
